Roles and permissions

The secretary opens and closes votes. Eligible board members review, comment and vote once. Invited observers have read-only access to released minutes.

Build prompt

Build “Board Vote & Policy Approval Tracker” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Attach a version identifier to each motion. Configure quorum and approval threshold from the board’s own rules. Record amendments and keep a timestamped decision history. The secretary opens and closes votes. Eligible board members review, comment and vote once. Invited observers have read-only access to released minutes. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

For a five-member sample board with quorum three and simple majority, two votes leave a motion pending. A third vote makes a 2–1 result eligible for approval. A repeated vote cannot increase turnout.
